tagline: A software studio crafting small but solid products
title: Software studio for small, solid apps
description: Zaco Labs is a small software studio. We make Waky, a mission alarm app; Dayline, an automatic travel log; and DUIRE, a Google Play closed testing service.
og_description: We make Waky, a mission alarm app; Dayline, an automatic travel log; and DUIRE, a Google Play closed testing service.
org_description: We build software that takes small frictions out of daily life and work.
about: Zaco Labs is a small software studio that starts from frictions we have run into ourselves.
We build only what is needed, and we stand behind what we build for the long haul.
waky_title: No more switching it off and going back to sleep
waky_body: An alarm that only stops once you solve a mission and an alarm sound recorded in your own voice make sure you get up — and once you do, it helps you keep your morning habits too.
waky_ld: An alarm you turn off by solving a mission, alarm sounds you record yourself, and morning habits.
dayline_title: Your day, drawn as a line
dayline_body: Where you went and how far is recorded automatically every day, with no start button. Your movement record stays on your device.
catcaptain_kind: Mobile app · iOS · Android · Korea only
catcaptain_title: A roll call for your neighborhood cats
catcaptain_body: Snap a stray cat on your walk and it recognizes whether it is one already in your collection. Check in each time you meet, and build a neighborhood cat collection with your neighbors.
catinroom_body: Focus for 25 minutes while your cat sits on the chair beside you, then rest for 5. Stay to the end and your cat leaves you a fish.
eightbillion_body: A life simulation game. Be born in a random country and era, and live one whole life from your first moments to the story you leave behind.
duire_title: Guarding the first 14 days of your new app
duire_body: We meet Google Play's closed testing requirement of 12 testers for 14 days with real Android devices, and keep every daily run in a final report.
